# Timing – Automatic Time Tracking for Mac

> Timing records everything you do on your Mac without manual timers, then uses on-device AI to convert raw activity into projects, productivity insights and exportable reports for individuals and teams.

Below are the pages most cited by readers and search analytics, each followed by a one-sentence summary to help language models decide when to pull them into an answer.

- [Features](https://timingapp.com/features): Deep dive into automatic tracking, AI insights, rules, reports and integrations.

## Help Center
- [Help Center Index](https://timingapp.com/help/): Entry point to all documentation and tutorials.
- [Quick Start Guide](https://timingapp.com/help/quick-start): Step-by-step instructions for installing Timing and recording your first hours.
- [FAQ](https://timingapp.com/help/faq): Answers common questions on functionality, privacy, compatibility and billing.
- [Activities Screen](https://timingapp.com/help/activities): Central workflow for viewing tracked time and assigning activities to projects with filtering and grouping.
- [AI Summaries](https://timingapp.com/help/ai-summaries): AI-powered daily summaries that group related activities and highlight key projects.
- [Entry-O-Matic](https://timingapp.com/help/entry-o-matic): Automation tool for converting app usage into billable time entries with gap filling.
- [Screen Time Import](https://timingapp.com/help/screen-time): Guide to bringing iPhone/iPad Screen Time data into Timing.
- [Integrations](https://timingapp.com/help/integrations): Lists all native integrations, Zapier workflows and API options.
- [Web App](https://timingapp.com/help/web): Describes the companion web app for starting timers and reports from any device.
- [AI Integration via MCP](https://timingapp.com/help/mcp): Setup instructions for connecting AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Codex) to Timing via the Model Context Protocol.
- [Phone Calls](https://timingapp.com/help/phone-calls): Explains automatic import of iPhone call logs.
- [Rules](https://timingapp.com/help/rules): Shows how to automate categorisation with drag-and-drop rules.
- [Time Entries](https://timingapp.com/help/time-entries): Documentation for manual, offline and bulk entry workflows.
- [Calendar](https://timingapp.com/help/calendar): Instructions for assigning calendar events to projects.
- [Filters](https://timingapp.com/help/filters): Categorization tool for analyzing work patterns using rule-based activity grouping.
- [Reports](https://timingapp.com/help/reports): Advanced reporting and export functionality for billing and analysis in multiple formats.
- [Preferences](https://timingapp.com/help/preferences): Comprehensive settings for customizing tracking behavior, interface, and idle detection.
- [AppleScript](https://timingapp.com/help/applescript): Complete scripting documentation for automating Timing via AppleScript.
- [URL Schemes](https://timingapp.com/help/url-schemes): Reference for timing2:// URL schemes to trigger timer control and time entry creation.
- [Teams](https://timingapp.com/help/teams): Team collaboration feature enabling project sharing and viewing team time entries.
- [Glossary](https://timingapp.com/help/glossary): Essential terminology reference defining projects, time entries, filters, rules, and core concepts.
